previous_findings.evidence: At D=0.0709 after advance(10), Screen remains (6,6,628,348), clipping enabled. The picture expands to (-3.42,0.78,646.84,358.44), but the bezel pixel remains unchanged. Picture, ghosts and static are children of Screen; the vignette draws above them.
The label still overlaps the picture at (233,10,174,27), now intentionally. It uses the HUDEarthFeed themed backing and draws above the overlay. All ten captures were visually inspected.
Local HEAD and GitHub PR #384 both identify dc9ac0d7c1d8da69c3a3eb060c9ba3c82c44c88a. Evaluated production files match that commit by SHA-256.

Expected colour now computes wavelength, matrix conversion, clipping, normalization, sRGB encoding and strength independently of EarthFeed helpers. Advanced slow and fast cases pass. Disabling Screen clipping causes the advanced RS-26 case to fail: bezel error 0.1961; suite becomes 24 passed, 1 failure.
Fallback is [400,650]. Removing visible_nm in the temporary probe confirms receding and approaching values clamp to 650 and 400 respectively.

non_blocking: Documentation retains contradictory 'never on the picture' wording, and the changelog still describes [400,650] as the eye's band. Update these to match the revised Processed overlay contract and indicator limits.
The golden's colour pipeline is independent of EarthFeed helpers but shares Blackbody.cmf; it does not independently validate the underlying CMF fit.
